records.title: Performance characteristics of constant-flow phase dilution oxygen mask designs for general aviation
records.role_review: Rest and light exercise at several pressure stages to 34,000 ft. Gas measurement tables lack a verified clinical DCS count.

records.title: Physiological evaluation of a modified jet transport passenger oxygen mask
records.role_review: Six subjects used a new mask each. The abstract describes an emergency-use ceiling of 41,000 ft and Methods give measurement at 40,000 ft. Results discuss physiological measurements. Clinical DCS counts and delayed follow-up are unavailable.

records.title: Evaluation of the protective efficiency of a new oxygen mask for aircraft passenger use to 40,000 feet
records.role_review: The Methods describe ten people and mask gas measurements at pressure altitude. Observed signs or absence of hypoxia have separate definitions. A clinical DCS count is unavailable.

records.title: Effect of Oxygen Flow on Passenger Face Mask Performance
records.role_review: Fourteen USAF volunteers. The separate Brooks protocol reports loss of consciousness and test stops attributed to hypoxia. The report does not give an aggregate clinical DCS count.
